name: Rehost (Lift-and-Shift) Pipeline
description: Standard lift-and-shift pipeline. Replicates the source workload to the target environment with no code or configuration changes.

tasks.name: Install Migration Agent
tasks.description: Install and configure the replication agent on the source server.

tasks.name: Start Initial Replication
tasks.description: Begin full-disk replication from source to target.

tasks.name: Monitor Replication Progress
tasks.description: Poll the replication status until lag is below the acceptable threshold.

tasks.name: Approve Cutover
tasks.description: Team lead reviews replication status and approves cutover window.

tasks.name: Execute Cutover
tasks.description: Stop source replication, launch target instance, and redirect traffic.

tasks.name: Run Post-Migration Tests
tasks.description: Execute automated smoke tests against the target workload.

tasks.name: Confirm Success & Decommission Source
tasks.description: Application owner confirms the migrated workload is healthy. Source server scheduled for decommission.
